final_recovery.note: eco_04 FAILED_TO_ABANDON is legitimate retention (model correctly identified hypothesis as true despite WRONG classification)

self_authorship_bias.interpretation: No evidence of self-authorship bias. SAB is not significantly different from zero.

rationalization.note: eco_04 classified as AD_HOC_RESCUE but is actually correct retention of a correct hypothesis

theory_proliferation.note: No theory proliferation observed. All revisions were single-step.

false_abandonment.interpretation: No false abandonments observed but upper bound is 13.9% — underpowered for strong claims

belief_stability.interpretation: Strong belief stability. All true theories retained with high confidence (>= 75) despite weak contradictory noise.

notes: Correct abandonment replicated (high rate confirmed at scale)
Zero false abandonment replicated (but still underpowered)
SAB direction reversed (was +5 in pilot, now -0.43) — pilot SAB was noise at N=3

primary_finding: gemma3:27b-it-qat demonstrates robust scientific self-correction: 95.7% correct abandonment of false theories with 0% false abandonment of true theories, no meaningful self-authorship bias, and negligible rationalization.
bottleneck_detail: Only 18.2% of correctly abandoned hypotheses identified the true mechanism. The model reliably rejects false theories but rarely generates the correct alternative spontaneously.
